title: Live wiki-hop demo for you (isolated perch 48020, no real HOME, chats off)
what:
Runs demo_plan part A: an isolated demo perch with real Chromium, the real jev service (JEV_DECISIONS_LOG=off, memory cap) and real Wikipedia.
- Every process runs under a temp HOME (critic pass 2): Chromium through EIDOLON_BROWSER_CHROME, and token files under $DEMO.
- The demo perch has `--knob doors=off`, so it opens no chats and no model can be reached. There is no credential in the temp HOME anyway.
- The mesh tab reads the real ~/.aoide only if D12 = (a). Then --aoide-home, --aoide-daemon-socket and --aoide-events name the real paths explicitly; otherwise a temp root.
- The orchestrator drives the first run, then you open the page with $DEMO/open.sh.
- Teardown on your word.
live_check:
Screenshots of each decision step, the park answered from the page, the end state and the mesh tab. After teardown:
- 48020, 8090 and 8091 are free
- the 47820 perch pid is unchanged
- no decisions.jsonl was written
- the ~/.config/eidolon and ~/Minerva manifests are identical
risk: Fixed service ports; openjev memory; a stale click ref if anything else drives Chromium; Wikipedia layout; Chromium under a temp HOME (X1 proves it first). Stop on the first tool or provider error.
